changes.note: A destination answering like an ordinary webhook (200 without the bound receipt) leaves the delivery UNKNOWN; only the receipt API proves COMMITTED. One POST.

An ordinary tenant revocation landing after the attempt and its spend are recorded is refused by the transport's pre-send recheck; nothing is delivered. The spent unit stays spent (release reports budget settlement pending), the conservative side.

The duplicate-delivery-key branch in BudgetedHttpAttempts is defence in depth: a repeat of the same permit is answered from the target's durable outcome before any send, so the branch is unreachable through the API and its removal is masked. Recorded as a layered limit, not a kill.

ReferenceManagedHost now carries the delivery attempts pool (receiver login) and a governance log (governor login) and offers egress_engine(policy) (the host engine's for_policy sibling: same recorder, approvals, emission, targets, budget and clock), delivery_target(endpoint, request, engine) (egress_delivery_target over that engine's budget, permit-use store and target authority) and deliver(...) (EgressAdmission.admit for the exact request, then the permit commit inside EgressAdmission.send while the tenant scope lock is held). PG composition test: an inventoried unregulated tenant delivers exactly once through the managed host; unknown scope and a regulated tenant without a declared egress action are refused before any request with the nonce unspent. The composition case uses EgressPolicy(approvers=0) (trusted machine endpoint); approval is exercised in test_x8_governed_egress_pg.py.

The X-15 coverage inventory still requires that, outside the ported driver, exactly the 4 reviewed provider capabilities construct network clients. Inside the governed driver (src/factory/public_fetch/drivers/stdlib.py), every connection construction must be one of the 3 catalogued egress boundary sites; its other http.client matches are imports, annotations, docstrings and exception references. The frozen covered-module absence check is unchanged. 054 shipped without this update: the author failed to run this static test before sealing.

The managed host has no default mission budget, so the fixture's host egress policy declares one explicitly (limit 4, units 1); an undeclared budget is refused fail-closed, which is the guard working.
